Name: Carpus
Role: Host at Troas who kept Paul's belongings
Summary: Carpus was the believer at Troas with whom Paul left his cloke, books, and parchments, which he asks Timothy to bring.
KeyStory: Carpus was the believer at Troas with whom Paul left his cloke, books, and parchments, which he asks Timothy to bring.
LifeLesson: Keeping another's books safe is a small trust that serves a great work.
